headlines.description: Désiré Doué scored twice to inspire Paris Saint-Germain to their first European Cup triumph with an emphatic 5-0 win over Inter Milan in a one-sided Champions League final on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: PSG humble Inter 5-0 to win Champions League final

keyEvents.text: Goal! Paris Saint Germain 1, Inter Milan 0. Achraf Hakimi (Paris Saint Germain) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Désiré Doué.

Goal! Paris Saint Germain 2, Inter Milan 0. Désiré Doué (Paris Saint Germain) right footed shot from the right side of the box to the top right corner. Assisted by Ousmane Dembélé following a fast break.
First Half ends, Paris Saint Germain 2, Inter Milan 0.
Second Half begins Paris Saint Germain 2, Inter Milan 0.
Substitution, Inter Milan. Yann Bisseck replaces Benjamin Pavard.
Substitution, Inter Milan. Nicola Zalewski replaces Federico Dimarco.
Nicola Zalewski (Inter Milan) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Inter Milan. Carlos Augusto replaces Henrikh Mkhitaryan.
Substitution, Inter Milan. Matteo Darmian replaces Yann Bisseck because of an injury.
Goal! Paris Saint Germain 3, Inter Milan 0. Désiré Doué (Paris Saint Germain) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Vitinha.
Désiré Doué (Paris Saint Germain) is shown the yellow card for excessive celebration.
Substitution, Paris Saint Germain. Bradley Barcola replaces Désiré Doué.
Marcus Thuram (Inter Milan) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Inter Milan. Kristjan Asllani replaces Hakan Çalhanoglu.
Francesco Acerbi (Inter Milan) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.

Goal! Paris Saint Germain 4, Inter Milan 0. Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Paris Saint Germain) left footed shot from the left side of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Ousmane Dembélé with a through ball.
Substitution, Paris Saint Germain. Lucas Hernández replaces Nuno Mendes.
Substitution, Paris Saint Germain. Gonçalo Ramos replaces Khvicha Kvaratskhelia.
Substitution, Paris Saint Germain. Senny Mayulu replaces Fabián Ruiz.
Substitution, Paris Saint Germain. Warren Zaïre-Emery replaces João Neves.
Goal! Paris Saint Germain 5, Inter Milan 0. Senny Mayulu (Paris Saint Germain) left footed shot from a difficult angle on the left to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Bradley Barcola.
Achraf Hakimi (Paris Saint Germain) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Second Half ends, Paris Saint Germain 5, Inter Milan 0.
